description: Land Acquisition - Galbadagama, Polgahawela D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Galahitiyawa and Horagolla, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for acquiring specific land parcels (34 lots and 17 lots) for public purposes, including exact locations, boundaries, and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
